criteria.name: Retaliation To Surveillance
criteria.description: Assess how militant targeting of civilians intensifies in response to government surveillance measures, particularly mandates perceived to threaten insurgent freedom of movement and financing.

criteria.name: Targeting Business Centers
criteria.description: Examine patterns of attacks on commercial hubs and business owners, especially those complying with security directives, and the resulting climate of fear and economic disruption.

criteria.name: Coercion And Compliance Dilemma
criteria.description: Analyze how militants pressure civilians to defy state directives while authorities demand compliance, creating a risk calculus that influences business operations and public behavior.

criteria.name: Urban Focus In Capital
criteria.description: Identify concentration of civilian targeting in major urban areas and neighborhoods, and how urban security initiatives shape attack locations and methods.

criteria.name: Methods Of Intimidation
criteria.description: Track the predominant tactics used against civilians—such as shootings, IEDs, and threats—and any shifts in modus operandi linked to policy changes or counter-insurgency pressure.

criteria.name: Extortion And Financing Pressure
criteria.description: Evaluate how attacks relate to preserving revenue streams from informal taxation, with violence used to enforce payment and deter measures that could expose collectors.

criteria.name: Counter-Insurgency Pressure Effects
criteria.description: Assess whether targeted operations against militant leadership correlate with short-term spikes or shifts in retaliatory violence against civilians.

criteria.name: Business Closures And Economic Impact
criteria.description: Measure how fear of retaliation and compliance uncertainty lead to market closures, reduced operating hours, and broader economic slowdowns.

criteria.name: Selective Compliance Patterns
criteria.description: Explore uneven adoption of surveillance mandates across districts and how differential compliance correlates with localized targeting risks.

criteria.name: Regional Variation In Violence
criteria.description: Compare intensity and forms of civilian targeting across regions, noting where militant focus shifts in response to security operations and political dynamics.

criteria.name: Security Forces And ATMIS Engagements
criteria.description: Contextualize civilian targeting within broader battle patterns between militants and security actors, noting spillover risks to bystanders.

criteria.name: Information Control And Surveillance Sabotage
criteria.description: Assess attempts to destroy or circumvent surveillance infrastructure and intimidate those facilitating data collection.

criteria.name: Political Tensions And Security Fallout
criteria.description: Analyze how federal–regional disputes and leadership changes affect security coordination, potentially creating openings for militant attacks on civilians.

criteria.name: Temporal Escalation Patterns
criteria.description: Identify periods of increased civilian targeting following specific government actions, security operations, or political milestones.

criteria.name: Civic Life Disruption
criteria.description: Evaluate broader social impacts, including restrictions on movement, altered daily routines, and erosion of trust in state protection.

criteria.name: Messaging And Psychological Warfare
criteria.description: Examine how militants use attacks to signal power, deter cooperation with authorities, and shape public narratives against surveillance.

criteria.name: Risk Mitigation Responses
criteria.description: Document adaptations by civilians and businesses—such as security measures, relocation, or non-compliance—to reduce exposure to targeting.

criteria.name: Urban-Rural Spillover Dynamics
criteria.description: Consider whether tactics used in the capital diffuse to other localities or remain concentrated based on surveillance and enforcement reach.

criteria.name: Event Type Shifts
criteria.description: Track changes in the balance between battles and remote/explosive violence and how these shifts influence civilian harm.

criteria.name: Humanitarian And Protection Needs
criteria.description: Assess emerging needs for protection, psychosocial support, and assistance for affected communities due to targeted intimidation and violence.
